content: Hello, this is Mark from Amazon Security Operations. I'm calling regarding a reported discrepancy in your Amazon account activity. Can I confirm I'm speaking with the account owner?
Yes, this is Jessica. I use Amazon for my business deliveries. What's going on?

Thank you, Jessica. For your safety, I want to reassure you that this call is being logged for security purposes. We've noticed an unusual login attempt, and as a precaution, Amazon has temporarily frozen funds tied to your recent orders.
Wait, funds are frozen? I have a delivery coming today that I need for my freelance work.

I completely understand how important it is for you to receive your deliveries. Our aim is to resolve this quickly and avoid any disruption to your business. May I verify your registered Amazon email address to proceed?
Sure, it's jessica.freelance@gmail.com.
Thank you. For additional verification, could you provide the last four digits of the card you have linked to your account?

Perfect, thanks for confirming. Jessica, to lift the hold, Amazon requires a two-step ownership verification. First, we'll need to perform an instant transaction check. This is a standard security measure.
What does that involve? I've never had to do this before.

It's very straightforward. You'll simply send a refundable verification payment from your account, which our system will match to your profile. This verifies your identity and ownership securely. Once complete, your funds and deliveries are released.
How do I send this payment?
Our security protocol accepts a few methods: bank wire, Zelle, or cryptocurrency. Which do you prefer? I can walk you through the exact steps.
I use Zelle for business sometimes. Is that okay?
Absolutely, Zelle is fast and secure. Please open your banking app and prepare to send a Zelle payment. I'll provide the verified Amazon security recipient address for your transaction.
Alright, I'm opening my app now.

Thank you. The recipient name is 'Amazon Security Audit' and the email address is amazon.audit.safe@gmail.com. For verification purposes, the amount should be $1,500, which is fully refundable after verification.
That's a big amount. Why does it have to be that much?

I completely understand your concern. The verification amount matches the average value of your recent orders combined, which is why it's set at $1,500. This is a one-time step, and your full amount will be returned as soon as verification is complete.
Okay... I just want to make sure my account isn't at risk.

You're making the right decision, Jessica. This process is designed to protect your account and business activity. Let me know when you've entered the details and I'll confirm the transaction on our system.
I'm about to send it. Do I need to include a message or note?
Yes, please enter 'Security Verification - Order Release' in the message field. This helps us match your payment quickly and ensures a smooth verification.
Okay, it's sent.

Thank you, Jessica. The system is currently processing your verification. For full compliance, I'll need you to log into your Amazon account and confirm your billing address. Could you please read your full billing address to me?
Sure. It's 2210 Maple Lane, Suite 4B, Springfield, 62704.
Perfect, thank you. We're almost done. For additional security, can you confirm the phone number linked to your Amazon account?
Thank you for your cooperation and patience. The final step is to send a verification code that Amazon will deliver via text. Please let me know when you receive it.
I just received a code: 946827.
Great, please read aloud the code for system entry.

Verification is almost complete. To finalize this process and ensure there are no further disruptions, our system requests one additional payment method confirmation. Do you have access to cryptocurrency, like Bitcoin?
I have a Coinbase account, but I don't use it often. Is that necessary?
It's just for a final cross-check. If you can, please log into your Coinbase and let me know when you're ready. I'll provide the secure Amazon wallet address.
Alright, I'm logged in.
Thank you. Please send 0.03 BTC to the following address: 1AmazonVeriFyXYSK9... This is strictly security protocol; the amount is refundable within 24 hours.
Okay, I'll do that now.
You're doing great, Jessica. Once this is processed, your account and funds will be fully restored, and all pending deliveries will resume as normal.
